llm.summary: This is mostly a read-only GatherUp connector skill, but its setup path includes unverified remote installer commands that deserve review before installation.

dimensions.detail: Use of the oo CLI and OOMOL server-side credentials is coherent for a GatherUp connector, but it gives access to connected GatherUp business/customer data and depends on the user's OOMOL account state.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: First-time setup instructs running remote installer scripts directly through Bash or PowerShell without a pinned version, checksum, signature, or explicit user confirmation gate.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger says to use the skill for any GatherUp request, which is broader than the four documented read actions, though the runtime instructions do not show hidden exfiltration or unrelated behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill describes one-time CLI installation, login, and GatherUp connection setup; no hidden services, background workers, memory writes, or privilege escalation are present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to read GatherUp business and customer data through OOMOL, and the listed actions are read-only: get_business, get_customer, list_businesses, and list_customers.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use this skill only for the listed read operations unless the publisher documents additional actions. Do not let an agent automatically run the remote installer commands; install the oo CLI through a verified method or inspect and verify the installer first, and avoid elevated shells unless required.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Downgraded: the artifact lists only read actions, and the generic write/destructive safety language does not prove actual mutation capability.
[SC2] expected: Accepted as a setup risk: installing the declared oo CLI dependency is purpose-aligned, but the documented pipe-to-shell commands are high-impact and unverified.
[SQP-1] expected: Partially accepted: routing GatherUp requests to this skill fits its purpose, but the word ANY is broader than the documented read-only action set.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Downgraded: the write/destructive text is ambiguous template safety guidance, while the available action list itself contains only reads.
[T03] expected: Accepted as the main review concern: the artifact tells users or agents to execute mutable remote installer scripts from cli.oomol.com without independent verification.
